source_statement: the owner assign the level needed

assignment_rule.binding_rule: The selected level, verifier policy or direct-verifier reference, package digest, scope, non-scope, and claim ceiling are bound into the package before verification begins.
assignment_rule.change_rule: Any level change after freeze creates a superseding package revision and restarts verification; a prior receipt cannot be stretched over the changed level.

proposed_level_vocabulary.effect: optional automated precheck for non-protected drafts only
a deterministic checker operating under exact Victor-Boscaro-owned policy and checker bytes issues the structural receipt
proposed_level_vocabulary.admission_effect: eligible only where the selected minimum-floor policy permits

proposed_level_vocabulary.effect: Victor Boscaro directly issues one exact digest-bound structural verification receipt
proposed_level_vocabulary.admission_effect: eligible for protected repository-local L1 admission when all other owner gates pass

proposed_level_vocabulary.effect: V2 plus separately governed external L2 identity or attestation evidence
proposed_level_vocabulary.admission_effect: unavailable until the separate external L2 gate is admitted

non_bypass_rule: Rondelli may raise the verification level. Whether and how far Rondelli may lower it is constrained by the still-pending non-bypassable minimum-floor decision.
claim_ceiling: This records a per-package verification-level Design rule and proposes a vocabulary for the next decision. It does not select a minimum floor, admit a checker or verifier policy, authenticate Victor Boscaro, verify a package, accept semantics, or authorize implementation, migration, promotion, publication, release, deployment, production effect, or Git work.
